text:
Amy (CEO): Quick heads-up — next Wednesday 11am PT we'll do a 45min fireside-style all-hands: product snapshot + Q&A. 30m update from product/eng, 15m open Qs. Please drop any questions in this thread or add to the form: https://forms.redwood.com/ah-qs :spiral_calendar:

Elaine - Product: Thanks! Agenda draft: 1) where we are re: latency/cost targets, 2) Dedicated rollout progress, 3) customer stories, 4) roadmap highlights. Will post slides by Tue EOD.

Mike DevEx: Can we add a 2-slide appendix on SDK changes and migration notes? small ask for ~3min.

Jamal - Eng: +1 on SDK. Also, any chance we can call out the model-routing/fallback improvements we shipped last sprint? customers will want details.

Amy (CEO): Yep — please keep the update high-level and ops-focused. If you need >3min, flag it here and we'll trim elsewhere. Jamal, include one bullet on fallback behavior and SLA impact.

Sarah - People Ops: Heads-up: we'll do a 2min hiring update after the product snapshot (rates, open roles) — nothing heavy, just the topline.

Mike DevEx: Noted. Also, can we record an explicit migration note for Dedicated customers (breaking changes)?

Elaine - Product: Good call. I'll add a migration section and link to the draft playbook.

Amy (CEO): For Qs — try to keep them specific (e.g., "will Dedicated support X quantization profile?"), that helps us surface answers during the 15m. If it's long, we'll have follow-up threads + a ticket.

Jamal - Eng: Quick question for leadership: are we planning any changes to the SLA for Dedicated in Q3?

Amy (CEO): Short answer: no SLA changes planned for Q3. We're focused on meeting current targets and delivering guarantees. We'll announce any changes at least 30 days in advance.

Elaine - Product: Slide upload: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/slides/draft-v1 — please comment by Tue noon.

Sarah - People Ops: Remote attendance note: we'll have captions and a short buffer after the recording for folks in APAC.

Mike DevEx: Will add the SDK migration note to the appendix by Tue.

Amy (CEO): Thanks team. I'll kick off with a 3min state-of-the-company context, then hand to Elaine/Jamal. If you have urgent Qs and can't make it, put them here and we'll try to prioritize. :thumbsup:

all-hands-bot: Recording will be posted here after the meeting — reminder set for 11:00am PT next Wed.

(After meeting) all-hands-bot: Recording: https://zoom.redwood.com/recordings/3123456789-product-fireside — transcript available in the drive.

Elaine - Product: Post-meeting notes: 1) Dedicated SLA items: no change in Q3; 2) fallback improvements reduced p99 latency by ~8% in internal tests; 3) SDK migration guide link: https://docs.redwood.com/sdk-migration. Will open a follow-up doc for detailed rollout schedule.

Jamal - Eng: Thanks — filing the follow-up ticket for the rollout details, cc @Mike DevEx.

Mike DevEx: Thanks all. Will post the small code snippet and changelog tomorrow.

Amy (CEO): Great session. Main takeaways: stay stable on SLA, finishing Dedicated rollouts, focus on SDK/migration comms. If anything critical pops up, ping me or Elaine.

Sarah - People Ops: Action: People Ops to share hiring one-pager by EOD Friday.

Amy (CEO): Closing — appreciate the quick prep everyone. :heart:
